Proposed test keeps that path and its durable owner instead of a mocked probe.

Captured metadata sets teamLaunch and oneShot false; providerStatusAuthority requires actual launch capability plus current authenticated authoritative catalog. The added composition test must retain that separation.

The unchanged peer can already accept the offered model/beta path at source level, and unchanged production utility already rejects stale aliases; those tests are preservation/composition obligations, with actual SDK behavior still to be observed.
